stories.title: Welsh Government sets out plan to end corridor care in hospitals across Wales
stories.summary: The Welsh Government wants more people who need hospital care in an emergency to be back home within 72 hours, where it is clinically appropriate, under a new plan published on Tuesday. stories.title: Sir Tom Jones to headline Llangollen Pavilion in June 2027
stories.summary: Sir Tom Jones will play an outdoor headline show at Llangollen Pavilion on Monday 28 June next year. Tickets for the fully seated concert go on sale at 10:00 GMT on Friday 20 November through llangollen.net and Ticketmaster. stories.title: Flintshire residents sought as volunteer police custody visitors
stories.summary: People in Flintshire are being asked to apply to become volunteer custody visitors, making unannounced checks on people held in police cells in North Wales.
